description: M1 is in triode at this bias; saturation imposed linearizes it with level-1 saturation equations (gm, gds and Meyer caps) at ngspice's V_GS, V_DS. Assumed values against indep.py's forced rebuild; the values stay ngspice's.

hand.gain: -(gm1 + gm2) (ro1 || ro2) at DC, gm1 = beta1 (1 + lambda V_DS1) V_ov1, ro1 = 2/(lambda beta1 V_ov1^2)
